notes:
Added optional Discord webhook alerts for selected instance events, including recovery and rejoin attempts.

Improved wireless pairing and saved-device reconnection, with notification pairing and easier support details.

Simplified Auto Recovery with per-instance switches, saved game targets, and optional unchanged-screen recovery.

Added game-link detection to prefill recovery targets when a usable Roblox link is available.

Improved touch-input handling to reduce delays during launches and recovery.

Improved white-preview diagnostics and Retry preview handling.

Added Start all and Restart running with spaced launches, restart confirmation, and ordered Roblox rejoin attempts.

Redesigned Logs with clearer entries and instance/event filters.

Matched instance numbering across Apps, Sessions, and Logs.

Improved clone-slot cleanup and clone-limit messages.

Added timer-pause support for eligible paid keys after the last device logs out and the authorization grace period ends.
